compute_uv_derivative: compute per-pixel UV derivative Jacobian matrices from mesh vertices, texture coordinates, and camera parameters
compute_inverse_jacobian: compute the inverse Jacobian of texture coordinates with respect to pixel-space position using screen_space_uv_derivative
compute_uv_grad_with_distortion: compute UV derivatives with optional camera distortion mode and distortion coefficients for accurate pixel-space gradients
review_screen_space_uv_derivative: review the screen_space_uv_derivative function to understand how it computes 2x2 Jacobian matrices for UV gradients
test_screen_space_uv_derivative: test the screen_space_uv_derivative function with mesh vertices, face indices, barycentric coordinates, and camera parameters
